touches.text: WHY: the base-most things (the six truths, logging, diagnostics, the core patterns) must be the same everywhere, so they are written once and inherited.
Logging and diagnostics, including diagnostic_inspector: the smart reader of the dumb breadcrumbs base's logging leaves; complete diagnosis on the first pass.
The base classes all inherit from base, and so bring its logging, diagnostics and core patterns with them:
scratch: a proof's throwaway temp dirs and worktrees, cleaned up by the door. WHY: a run must leave nothing behind (4.3.1.7). USERS: the tester.
